title: A small beginning before the whole design

captions.energy: Requiring a complete design before participation

meaning: An available beginning supports leisure when uncertain choice and requiring a whole design allow both to step beyond waiting.
text: A complete design can become a condition of the smallest beginning. The Moon in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes tentative choice without final clarity. The World in energy leans towards requiring leisure’s finished picture before participating. The Hanged Man in emotions leaves a feeling of delay before enjoyment. Both may feel every part of the evening must first find its place. A pleasant separate action then seems insufficient. Its value waits although a free trial could already provide an actual impression and suggest what follows.

For example, you choose a film without deciding whether to watch it all or walk afterwards. Browsing takes time and the evening seems unable to begin. **A small beginning need not contain all the leisure that follows.** You can choose a short excerpt through mutual interest and decide later about continuing. Participation need not close every possibility. An impression offers more support than an ideal scheme without experience.

The difficulty is treating an open ending as a defect. You delay something pleasant for complete agreement and feel increasingly still. Another perspective helps when restoring a small step. Both may discover interest while taking part. Leisure can form gradually, preserving freedom to finish without filling the entire programme. A modest beginning gains its own value even when a clear picture of the rest never appears.
